title: Singapore Clinical Trial Site Operations
thesis: Snowflake turns daily site-level activity from 40 trial sites of a fictional Singapore contract research organisation into enrollment-vs-plan and monitoring KPIs, 7-day important-deviation risk scores, data query anomalies and grounded AI answers, all on curated dynamic tables, with no patient data.

talking_points: Enrollment vs plan, participants enrolled, screen failure rate and important deviations for 40 sites in 5 Singapore planning areas: Novena, Outram, Queenstown, Jurong East and Tampines.
Every KPI is a numerator over a denominator in a curated dynamic table, so it can be traced back to site-day rows.
The signal-type chart shows which central-monitoring signals turn into important deviations and which are mostly not confirmed.
tabs.call_out: One governed set of trial operations KPIs, traceable to source rows

transition.line: Which sites should central monitoring look at first?

talking_points: Snowflake ML classification scores each site's probability of a confirmed important deviation in the next 7 days. It is an operational score, not a clinical prediction.
The holdout line shows precision and recall on the most recent labelled days, against the base rate.
Anomaly detection flags data query rate outliers per site, and the forecast projects network-wide enrollment for 14 days.
tabs.call_out: Honest, evaluated ML inside the data platform

transition.line: Is our monitoring keeping up across the island?

talking_points: Monitoring visit compliance, essential document coverage and pending documents frame the site management gaps.
Monitoring compliance against important deviations by site shows where missed visits and deviations move together; it is an association, not proof of cause.
The action memo drafts three prioritised site-management actions from the KPI, site, signal-type and risk tables only.
tabs.call_out: Grounded draft actions, with a human in the loop

transition.line: What happens when a late visit record lands right now?

talking_points: Live visit-record events land in RAW.LIVE_VISITS, from the simulator or from Amazon Data Firehose through Snowpipe. They carry no patient identifiers.
The Snowflake alert logs ALERT events with an SOP hint and the site's current risk band, then emails the central monitoring team.
tabs.call_out: From visit record to follow-up in one platform

talking_points: The Cortex Agent uses Cortex Analyst over the semantic view for metrics, and Cortex Search over 13 synthetic site-management SOPs.
Ask for enrollment vs plan by planning area; each answer shows the generated SQL and the SOPs it cited.

transition.line: Here is how it is built.

talking_points: Two builds share one core: Snowflake only, or AWS + Snowflake (Data Firehose, Bedrock, QuickSight and Amazon Q).
Everything shown is synthetic, site-level demo data, rebuilt reproducibly from the repo.
tabs.call_out: One governed core, with an optional AWS edge
